case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You wrote that your CNC machines are ready to put this job onto the shop floor, and that is exactly why we are writing to you first for the HX series pump shaft. Option A is built so that your machines are put to work on a part from a family company that has long been your reference customer.

On quality:
Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

On price:
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

Because of these two points, we cannot approve your offer as it stands. Option A is the package we can approve: it is a fair price for both family companies, and it gives you a clear job for your free capacity with prompt payment.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.61; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

We have kept the proposal simple so that you can decide it yourself without long internal rounds. Please look at it as one owner to another, and let me know whether Option A works for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. 

Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Because you offer 14 days payment, which helps us out, I will beat that price and go down to €30.50. 

So our Angebot is a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Let's agree on this so we can get the machines making chips.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You wrote that faster payment is welcome and that you can reflect it in the price, and that is the point on which Option A is built: the payment term you asked for, with your machines running on the HX series pump shaft.

That is the kind of openness we expect from a long-standing partner.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 26.92; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.11; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the quicker payment you asked for and a lead time that stays as you proposed, at a price we consider fair for both family companies.

As owner, you can decide this yourself. Please look at Option A as it stands. It brings work onto your shop floor from a customer who values what you have done for us, and we would like to build on that together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a reliable, long-term partner, and our options are built around that. Each gives you a clear price, payment term and lead time to plan against, so your capacity can be scheduled with confidence.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 62.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

On the cost side:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 25.99; payment 90 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 25.84; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 25.76; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve. It reflects the delivery record and the bar-stock price movement above, and it gives you the longest payment term of the three, with a lead time we can plan around.

We would like to build the HX series shaft supply with you on a firm, steady footing. Please let me know which option works for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Our offer is a price of €34.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Payment at 45 days from your Option C is fine by us, let me know if we have a deal! But 35 days lead time is crazy tight for our production right now, we really need to keep it at 52 days so we don't let you down.

Alternatively, under standard terms with Lieferzeit 52 days: €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

Another supplier has offered EUR 36.00 for this part (offer:70210-0).

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70250@2026Q3).

Option A: unit price EUR 27.97; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.12; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
